title: Existential alternating successor step
statement: Let $V$ be a language of binary strings, let $m,k\in\mathbb{N}$, and let $w$ be a binary string. In the alternating quantifier construction, the predicate at $k+1$ rounds with initial existential quantification holds for $w$ exactly when there is a binary string $u$ of length $m$ for which the predicate at $k$ rounds with initial universal quantification holds on the pair encoding of $w$ and $u$.
